# Handmade for tests/test_FP1.py, in the syntax of common/national_focus/*.txt (not copied from the game).
# Eight GER focuses: two roots, an OR child, an AND child, a pair that excludes each other (declared on one side
# only, as the game's files often do), a focus whose `available` asks for a focus NOT done, and a DLC branch.
# A second tree for ITA checks that the tree claiming the tag is the one read.

@long_cost = 10

focus_tree = {
	id = test_german_focus

	country = {
		factor = 0
		modifier = {
			add = 10
			tag = GER
		}
	}

	default = no

	focus = {
		id = GER_root_a
		icon = GFX_goal_generic_construct_civ_factory
		x = 0
		y = 0
		cost = 5
		available = {
		}
	}

	focus = {
		id = GER_root_b # cost from a variable
		x = 4
		y = 0
		cost = @long_cost
		available = {
			has_war = no
		}
	}

	focus = {
		id = GER_or_child
		prerequisite = { focus = GER_root_a focus = GER_root_b }
		x = 2
		y = 1
		cost = 7
		search_filters = { FOCUS_FILTER_INDUSTRY }
	}

	focus = {
		id = GER_and_child # no cost: the game's default, 10
		prerequisite = { focus = GER_root_a }
		prerequisite = { focus = GER_root_b }
		x = 2
		y = 2
	}

	focus = {
		id = GER_left
		prerequisite = { focus = GER_or_child }
		mutually_exclusive = { focus = GER_right }
		relative_position_id = GER_or_child
		x = -1
		y = 1
		cost = 5
		will_lead_to_war_with = POL
	}

	focus = {
		id = GER_right
		prerequisite = { focus = GER_or_child }
		relative_position_id = GER_or_child
		x = 1
		y = 1
		cost = 5
		available = {
			has_government = fascism
		}
		bypass = {
			has_war_with = POL
		}
	}

	focus = {
		id = GER_after_left
		prerequisite = { focus = GER_left }
		x = -1
		y = 2
		relative_position_id = GER_or_child
		cost = 2
		available = {
			NOT = { has_completed_focus = GER_root_b }
		}
	}

	focus = {
		id = GER_dlc_branch
		prerequisite = { focus = GER_root_a }
		allow_branch = {
			has_dlc = "Test DLC"
		}
		x = 0
		y = 1
		cost = 4
		completion_reward = {
			add_political_power = 50 # "a # inside a comment"
			custom_effect_tooltip = "text with # and { braces }"
		}
	}
}

focus_tree = {
	id = test_italian_focus
	country = { factor = 0 modifier = { add = 10 tag = ITA } }
	focus = { id = ITA_only cost = 5 }
}
